name: distance
description: metres between two positions (haversine, earth radius 6,371,000 m)

name: bearing
description: initial bearing from a to b, degrees true, 0 <= x < 360

name: courses_cross
description: where two courses cross: the crossing within range (metres, default 200 km) of pos1, or nil

name: lines_cross
description: where the great circles through a1-a2 and b1-b2 cross: the crossing within range of a1, or nil

name: course_crosses_line
description: where a course crosses the great circle through a-b: the crossing within range of pos, or nil

name: angle_diff
description: heading a minus heading b, degrees, wrapped to -180..180 (positive: a is clockwise of b); extreme-race's simple_diff, in degrees
